formatter.settings_source: libtmux-julia dev/check-quality.jl formats its sources with these options at margin 92; the documentation surface uses margin 60 (CODE_COLUMNS.api).
formatter.method: Each input is the extracted signature normalized by format_text at margin 100000, so only its line breaks are left to decide. The formatter then ran at margin 60. The extractor spells types with spaces and bare where variables, which the formatter rewrites; layouts keep those tokens, so inputs use the formatter spelling.
formatter.regenerate: julia --project=<scratch> -e 'using JuliaFormatter; fmt(s; margin) = JuliaFormatter.format_text(s; style=DefaultStyle(), indent=4, margin=margin, format_docstrings=false, whitespace_in_kwargs=false); input = strip(fmt(raw; margin=100000)); formatted = strip(fmt(input; margin=60))'
